title: Prestige Group buys 50 pc stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for Rs 500 cr
summary: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd has successfully acquired a 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for an estimated Rs 500 crore. This partnership is set to develop a commercial project in Andheri, Mumbai, spanning 21,978.22 square meters, with projected leasable space of 1.50 million square feet. The total project valuation is forecasted at approximately Rs 4,500 crore, marking a significant expansion for Prestige in the Mumbai real estate market.

title: Gateway Distriparks to operate, manage common rail yard terminal at JNPA
summary: Gateway Distriparks Limited has gained a mandate for operating the common rail yard terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. This terminal will enhance the handling of container trains and improve the efficiency of cargo movement. The contract spans eight years, focusing on train handling, container stacking, and inter-terminal transfers. Gateway aims to work closely with JNPA to improve rail connectivity for trade.

title: IndoSpace launches 1.05M sq ft Narasapura-II industrial and logistics park in Karnataka
summary: IndoSpace has launched Narasapura-II, an industrial and logistics park in Karnataka with a size of approximately 1.05 million square feet. The company announced an investment of Rs 350 crore to enhance its presence in the region. This park aims to support businesses across various sectors including e-commerce and manufacturing. The location in Narasapura is strategically chosen for its connectivity to Bengaluru's markets.

title: Real estate firm Assetz gets Sebi nod to float Rs 1,200-cr IPO
summary: Assetz Ltd has obtained approval from Sebi to proceed with its plans for an initial public offering. The company aims to raise around Rs 1,200 crore in this IPO process. Assetz has developed a substantial land bank and project pipeline to meet housing demand in Bengaluru. With strong backing from investors like AGP Partners, the firm is expanding its presence in key markets.
